title: CyberAlchemy v2 definition migration normalization

source_refs.role: selected context, artifact, projection, and recursion architecture

decision_evidence.range: D1 through D69 plus D70-D81 withdrawal preservation
decision_evidence.limitation: The selections were made interactively. This package is their first repository-local synthesis and is not a canonical promotion decision.

normalization_rules: Create a distinct artifact type only when source direction, validation closure, lifecycle, authority behavior, or relation semantics differ materially.
Use one lifecycle-profile artifact type with owner-selected vocabularies instead of embedding lifecycle state in stable semantic artifacts.
Use one evaluation envelope with evaluation profiles unless a result has a distinct authority or execution contract.
Use typed-relation records and relation kinds instead of redundant inverse lists or directory-inferred membership.
Keep construction, implementation, model-instance, and capability-realization bindings distinct because their closure and validation obligations differ.
Keep the machine record canonical and generate every human projection deterministically.
Treat Product, Project, CAV2 Context, DDD Bounded Context, capability instance, artifact type, semantic kind, authority kind, and directory as independent axes.
Do not import CyberAlchemy-v2 source bytes as admitted Lab authority without exact source admission and an owner decision.
Preserve dropped and withdrawn identifiers as lineage or tombstone evidence; never silently reuse them.

distill.target_context: A draft migration model for 69 audited shared definitions and 12 withdrawn identifiers.
distill.output_artifact: One machine-canonical normalization with generated human projection and validation receipt.
distill.optimization_goal: Minimize artifact-type duplication without erasing distinct semantic, authority, lifecycle, binding, or validation obligations.

rounds.proposer_claim: Normalize repeated lifecycle, evaluation, policy, receipt, and typed-relation mechanics into reusable artifact families.
rounds.evidence_or_assumption: The D1-D69 decisions repeatedly proposed domain-specific lifecycle profiles, evaluations, receipts, and relations with the same source direction and authority_effect none.
rounds.balancer_objection: A generic family could erase domain-specific closure rules and make one schema appear to validate every meaning.
rounds.reconciliation: Keep shared envelopes but require exact profiles and owner-local schemas; profile validity never proves domain meaning or authority.

rounds.proposer_claim: Normalize every proposed binding into one generic binding type.
rounds.evidence_or_assumption: Bindings share exact endpoints, versions, digests, owners, challenge routes, and authority_effect none.
rounds.balancer_objection: Construction, implementation, model-instance, and capability-realization bindings have different endpoint kinds, predecessor closure, invalidation rules, and conformance obligations.
rounds.reconciliation: Reject the generic binding type. Preserve four specialized binding artifact types over shared artifact mechanics.

smallest_coherent_unit.name: normalized migration record
smallest_coherent_unit.responsibility: Connect one legacy decision to deduplicated semantic concepts, artifact types, profiles, relation kinds, owner scopes, derived surfaces, and migration dependencies.
smallest_coherent_unit.reason_not_smaller: A legacy-to-term map alone cannot prevent type, lifecycle, relation, context, or projection collapse.
smallest_coherent_unit.reason_not_larger: Canonical definitions, schemas, generators, validators, and admitted context instances belong to successor migrations, not this synthesis.

distill.next_route: owner review then bounded definition and artifact-type authoring

unresolved_decisions.question: Which owner scopes become DDD Bounded Contexts?
unresolved_decisions.blocking_for: context directory creation and context-map authority
unresolved_decisions.recommended_default: Do not infer any; select each with language, scope, exclusions, owner, and directional maps.

unresolved_decisions.question: Should the generic evaluation envelope use one schema plus profiles or separate subtype schemas?
unresolved_decisions.recommended_default: One envelope with owner-local subtype schemas bound through exact profiles.

unresolved_decisions.question: Which normalized artifact type is the first admitted vertical witness?
unresolved_decisions.recommended_default: Definition/v1 because all later semantic artifacts depend on its voice and projection contract.

unresolved_decisions.question: Where will durable owner decisions for D1-D69 be recorded?
unresolved_decisions.recommended_default: Create one immutable normalization decision bound to this JSON digest after review.

unresolved_decisions.question: Which legacy DS identifiers remain active aliases after the Craft rename?
unresolved_decisions.recommended_default: Preserve identifiers initially as lineage aliases; change display names without identity churn.
